Ek chatur tippani jeebh par dhalas sona hai.
Hansi samajhdari ka sangeet hai.
Daya samaj ki sone ki zanjeer hai.
Chalak chaal brute taakat ko hara deti hai.
Chalak khoji moorkhata ko hawa ki tarah use karta hai.
Ahankari dil vastavikta se takra kar toot ta hai.
Hum swayam ke samudra par ajnabee ki tarah chalte hain.
Hum rahasya ki duniya me nakshe dhoondhte hain.
Jo ujaale se bhage, chhaya unka peecha kare.
Hum bandar ki suraksha ke liye apni azadi bechte hain.
Buddhi sabse andhere ghanton mein chamakti hai.
Jigyasa duniya ka kinaara dhoondh leti hai.
Log wahi dekhte hain jo unka dimaag karne deta hai.
Gyaani apane vichaaron mein khush rehta hai.
Buddhi devtaon ki hansi hai.
Ek chalak aasan hazaron talwaron ke barabar hai.
Dimaag shaant vichar mein apna langar daalta hai.
Bina gyan ke chalaki bina patwar ki naav hai.
Vyang wo namak hai jo baasi aatma ko bachata hai.
Ek chalak saazish samrat ko maat de deti hai.
Satya shaant beech mein mile.
Hum mahatvakanksha ki ret par kile banate hain.
Jo ek hi patthar par do baar thokar khaaaye, vah moorh hai.
Teekhi buddhi sabse tez barbaadi se aage nikal jaati hai.
Dil ek purane taal par dhadakta hai.
Ek chatur chaal gardan ko rassi se bachati hai.
Paani kathor se kathor patthar ko bhi kaat deta hai.
Teekha jawab chatur ka kavach hota hai.
Ek chalak mazak zakhi rooh ko theek karta hai.
Dil sabse thande tark ko thukra deta hai.
Dil ke paas wo wajehein hain jo vichar nahi jaante.
Rooh kismat ke tarashe raaston par chalti hai.
Teekha mazak gyaani ka hathiyar hai.
Sab kuch badal raha hai; kuch sthir nahi.
Irshya vah zehar hai jo khud peeya jaye.
Insaani rooh andheri gufaon mein roshni dhoondti hai.
Moorh suraj mein bhi dosh dhundhe.
Azaad insaan kisi ka gulam nahi hota.
Man chhaaiyon ka rangmanch hai.
Buddhi tez vichar ki khubsurti hai.
Aatma ka samudra vichar ke aakash ko darshata hai.
Dukhad anubhav heere ko chamkaaye.
Buddhi tark ke galiyaaron mein roshni hai.
Ek chalak dhokha pavitra mukhote ke peeche chhupta hai.
Dil ek aisa dhokebaaz hai jo dimaag ki nahi sunta.
Shanti shant vichaaron ki fasal hai.
Insaani dil ek anjaana jangal hai.
Chalak jubaan ek taakatwar samrajya hai.
Ahankaari hamesha sharminda ho.
Dil jaane-pehchane sapnon mein panah dhoondhta hai.
